Use case: stylized-concept. Production hand-painted2D tactical RPG animation atlas matching supplied character EXACTLY. An adult lean human spearman with a readable stern face, simple rounded iron cap helmet with open face, grey chain coif over brown padded leather tunic, muted rust waist sash, dark brown trousers, leather gloves and proportional plain leather boots. A long straight ash-wood spear with small steel leaf point, held by TWO well separated hands in fighting stance; the rear hand near butt and front hand midway up shaft. No shield, no sword. Spear length about 1.9m for a 1.7m man, no flags. Camera: orthographic shallow18-degree elevation, STRICT RIGHT SIDE PROFILE, looking and moving to screen-right; see right-facing nose silhouette, one side of torso; NO front or rear3/4, same facing in ALL44cells. Maintain functional anatomical handedness; do not mirror weapon hands. Detailed painted brushwork/crisp material edges, warm muted light. Proportional anatomy, gloves, modest sensible boots. True clean transparency, no floor/shadow/text/labels/fringe. Large tall output2048x3840. EXACT4 COLUMNS x11 ROWS,44 separate fully visible figures, generous cell margins including weapons and lying body. SAME body size/head size in every row.
ROW1 four NEUTRAL IDLE breathing poses with relaxed upright straight legs, weapon safely lowered.
ROW2 four COMBAT IDLE breathing poses, weapon prepared forward at chest height.
ROWS3-4 EIGHT-frame natural NEUTRAL WALK loop, alternate left/right heel contact, loading, toe off, passing foot, normal modest stride, credible knee flexion.
ROWS5-6 EIGHT-frame natural COMBAT WALK loop, keep weapon in raised ready guard while feet alternate; never revert to weapon dangling at thigh.
ROWS7-8 EIGHT-frame ATTACK: one TWO-HANDED spear thrust: braced front guard, rear hand draws shaft back, coil torso, short step, both hands extend shaft toward facing/target, maximum thrust, pull shaft back, front guard. TWO separated hands on one rigid straight shaft, leaf point same size/length.
ROW9 FOUR HIT frames: shoulder struck, recoil, stabilize feet, return guard.
ROWS10-11 EIGHT DEATH/FALL frames: struck, torso buckles, knees bend, knee ground, hand floor, body falls onto side, lands, final full body lying still. No gore. Articulated fall not rigid upright rotation. Fixed camera and facing, full silhouettes. Rows are chronological left to right; no omitted cells. Every sword/shaft remains straight and SAME physical length.
